model.name: empero-ai/Qwen3.8-2B-Distill-GGUF
model.architecture: Qwen3.5 hybrid Gated DeltaNet plus full attention

tokenizer.source: tokenizer.ggml.* fields embedded in the GGUF model

macos_ane.lm_head: host fp32 reference until Linux supports the complete head

linux_ane.runtime: Linux ANE runtime in this repository
linux_ane.fallback: forbidden; any ANE failure must terminate the run

linux_cpu.runtime: same model and tokenizer with host tensor math

measurement.cold_start: process launch through the first complete 32-token decode, with model load and compilation reported separately
measurement.steady_state: after model load, graph compilation, and warmup; includes all prompt and generated-token model computation
measurement.time_to_first_token: token IDs ready through the first selected generated token
measurement.prefill_tokens_per_second: prompt token count divided by prompt forward time
measurement.decode_tokens_per_second: 32 generated tokens divided by generated-token forward time
measurement.end_to_end: token IDs ready through the 32nd selected generated token
measurement.memory: peak resident set size for the measured process
measurement.ane_submissions: count every ANE submission used for model computation, reported per generated token
measurement.confidence_interval: paired bootstrap 95 percent confidence interval over the ten measured repetitions

hardware.comparison: same physical Apple M1 system in Linux and macOS when possible
hardware.linux: Apple M1 8-core CPU, 16 GB memory, Omarchy Linux
hardware.macos: the same Apple M1 system and memory size
hardware.controls: no other model server or accelerator workload; record OS, kernel, runtime, and compiler revisions

numeric_thresholds.basis: three repeated 32-token macOS ANE runs were deterministic with zero measured logit delta
numeric_thresholds.policy: do not loosen after observing a Linux mismatch
